Hamid Shekarchi as interim chief financial officer, effective immediately.

Shekarchi previously served as chief financial officer of the company’s Canadian cannabis business and brings 18 years of financial leadership experience. He succeeds Steve Ruffini, who remains a member of leadership team overseeing mergers and acquisitions.
His appointment follows the completion of a thorough search process as part of the company’s previously announced CFO succession plan, which was disclosed on April 3, 2026.

title: Village Farms names Hamid Shekarchi as interim CFO
